roads.name: Morrow Mountain Road
words: Properly twisty: 24 curves in 3.9 miles, about 6 a mile.
From 305 to 620 ft, with 781 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 90°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 25 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.13 g.
